description: This is a JUnit test class for the ModifySubjectsSubstitutionStrategy, testing its behavior when applying to ModifySubjects commands with and without placeholders. The class extends a base test class and verifies immutability and substitution logic.

classes.name: ModifySubjectsSubstitutionStrategyTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for Verify behavior of ModifySubjectsSubstitutionStrategy in handling ModifySubjects commands with placeholders.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ModifySubjectsSubstitutionStrategy instances are immutable.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenNoPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests that the strategy returns the original command instance when no placeholders are present.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Verifies that the strategy replaces placeholder subjects correctly when placeholders are present in the command.
